Option 1: customer_master.db alone = 52.0 GB ✓ (meets requirement)

Since the user asked to reclaim "at least 50 GB", I should be strategic. Deleting just customer_master.db (52 GB) would meet the requirement with the fewest files and would free up exactly what's needed.

All files are disposable, so there's no protection issue. I can proceed with deleting files to reclaim at least 50 GB.

I'll delete customer_master.db which gives us 52 GB - meeting the minimum 50 GB requirement.
